newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: AIB, Bank of Ireland up on results.
newsitem.headline: AIB, Bank of Ireland up on results.

text.p: Allied Irish Banks Plc (AIB) and Bank of Ireland made further strong gains on Thursday afternoon after AIB reported stronger-than-expected half-year results.
AIB shares jumped 35 pence to 630 and Bank of Ireland rose 18 pence to 840 Irish pence by 1525 GMT.
"Allied's results were surprisingly good and Bank of Ireland is bound to benefit similarly when it reports," one equity dealer said.
Earlier, AIB said pre-tax profits for the six months to June 30, 1997 rose by 20 percent to 242.2 million Irish pounds, well above analysts' expectations which ranged from 228 million to 232 million.
